title: workspace-standards — one entry point to review, run, and apply every workspace standard
description: Use this when a workspace standard (testing first) must be reviewed, run for a change, or applied to a repository, or when role routing or gates need review. The command /workspace-standards with a verb (review, run, or apply) and a target loads that target's playbook; a target is a foundation (routing, gates) or a registered standard (testing).
author: sox-ecosystem

target.description: A foundation (routing, gates), a registered standard (testing), or all (review and apply only).

playbook.description: Skill-relative path of the playbook the verb loaded, or a named error code.
